subject: unilateral-mistake
citation: Chwee Kin Keong and others v Digilandmall.com Pte Ltd [2005] SGCA 2, [2005] 1 SLR(R) 502, with the comparators the encoding reads against it
note:
THE SUBJECT IS JUDGE-MADE LAW, so this bundle is shaped unlike a statute bundle. There is no in-force banner to record because a judgment has no commencement, and `in_force_absent_reason` says so. There is no annotation inventory because a judgment carries no amendment markers; `annotations` is therefore absent from every document rather than empty, and P2's completeness join over it cannot run. ONLY THE TWO SINGAPORE JUDGMENTS WERE ACTUALLY RETRIEVED AND HASHED. The English and Australian authorities were NOT fetched: every quotation of them in the encoding is a quotation of Chwee Kin Keong's account of them, which is why they appear here as a single `scholarship`-role note rather than as documents. The American rule was FIRST retrieved through a summarising fetch, which returned extracted quotations rather than bytes and could not be pinned. That was not good enough and it was redone: caselaw.findlaw.com has no capture, and law.justia.com and courtlistener.com both refuse a plain client (403 and a 202 challenge), so the opinion was taken from a Wayback capture of the Justia page, which IS pinned and hashed. Doing so paid for itself immediately -- see the note on donovan-2001 below.

PER-DOCUMENT NOTES (the schema allows no `note` on a document, so they are collected here):

[ckk-ca-2005] THE source. Decided 13 January 2005. The lawplain MCP's structured record for this citation TRUNCATES the body at 60,000 characters against a stated body_length of 87,030, which silently drops the whole of 'Our decision' -- paragraphs 88 to 99, where the holdings on each appellant are. The complete text was obtained by fetching the eLitigation page directly. Anyone relying on the MCP record alone would have encoded the doctrine without the paragraphs that apply it.

[quoine-ca-2020] Decided 24 February 2020, five judges. Establishes that Chwee Kin Keong is still the test, and supplies fixture 8. Read for [13] and [16] only; the judgment is 203,459 characters and the rest of it -- implied terms, trusts, unjust enrichment, and the dissent -- was not read and is not encoded.

[donovan-2001] Supplies the Restatement text, the four California elements, and fixture 7 (advertised US$25,995 against an actual US$37,995, the buyer unaware). RE-RETRIEVING THIS DOCUMENT PROPERLY FOUND A REAL DEFECT. The first, unpinnable fetch had returned a SUMMARY, and one of its sentences -- that the court "adopted the rule in section 153, subdivision (a) ... as California law" -- was carried into us-unilateral-mistake.l4 inside quotation marks. It is not in the opinion: it is the summarising model's paraphrase. report/verify-quotations.py caught it against the pinned capture, and it is now replaced by what the court actually wrote, which is both verifiable and stronger. A paraphrase wearing quotation marks is the exact failure that quote-hygiene discipline exists to prevent, and it reached the encoding.

[ckk-foreign-authorities] NOT A SEPARATE RETRIEVAL, and listed as its own document precisely so that it cannot be mistaken for one. The English and Australian authorities behind the ew- and au- modules were never fetched from their own reports; they are read entirely through the passages of Chwee Kin Keong cited above, which is the same bytes as ckk-ca-2005. The role is `scholarship` because that is what a secondary account of an authority is, however authoritative its author. See NOTES.md section 3.

NO `retrieval_cost` IS RECORDED, and its absence is deliberate. The schema requires `elapsed_ms` whenever the object is present, and the fetches here were made through tools that did not time themselves. A fabricated figure would be indistinguishable from a measured one, which is the failure the field exists to prevent, so the object is omitted rather than filled in. Four requests were made and roughly 336KB captured; those two numbers are counted from the session, not measured by an instrument, and are recorded here in prose where they cannot be mistaken for telemetry.
in_force_absent_reason: A judgment is not enacted and has no in-force date, no revised edition and no currency banner. The nearest equivalent -- whether the decision still represents the law -- is a question for the sweep in external-modifications.json, and that sweep is recorded there as incomplete.

assembled.note: The primary judgment as captured, verbatim HTML. Every quotation in the encoding was extracted mechanically from a text rendering of this file (tags stripped, entities unescaped, paragraphs split on the leading paragraph number), never retyped from memory. A reviewer checking a quotation should re-derive the text from this file rather than from the live site, which may have been re-rendered since.
